description: Na₃SiSe₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four SiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SiSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.11 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SiSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-20°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.26 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.25 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with three SiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four NaSe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SiSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-18°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.14 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with two SiSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 12°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.19 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four Se atoms to form SiSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-71°. There are a spread of Si-Se bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.35 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four Se atoms to form SiSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with three NaSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-67°. There are a spread of Si-Se bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.35 Å. There are eight inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one Si atom to form distorted SeNa₄Si trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₅Si octahedra, edges with three SeNa₅Si octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Si trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Si, and one Se atom. The Se-Se bond length is 2.40 Å. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Si atom to form distorted SeNa₅Si octahedra that share corners with two SeNa₅Si octahedra, edges with six SeNa₅Si octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Si trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-24°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Si atom. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Si, and one Se atom. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Si atom to form distorted SeNa₅Si octahedra that share corners with two SeNa₅Si octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄Si trigonal bipyramid, edges with six SeNa₅Si octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Si trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-11°. In the seventh Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Si atom to form SeNa₅Si octahedra that share corners with two SeNa₅Si octahedra, edges with four SeNa₅Si octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄Si trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-24°. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom.
